name: Jiangxi Jiangnan New Material Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangxi Jiangnan New Material Technology Co., Ltd. is an international enterprise focused on the innovation, production, and distribution of sophisticated copper-based materials. Their diverse product range includes copper anodes, high-purity oxygen-free copper, copper oxide, various copper chemicals, and even copper coinage. These essential materials cater to a wide array of industries, such as printed circuit board (PCB) manufacturing, surface finishing, general electronics, semiconductor fabrication, and plate production. The firm was established in 2007 and has its principal headquarters located in Yingtan City, China.
